title: Jesse Walden - A Primer on NFTs - [Invest Like the Best, EP. 218]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Jesse Walden, the founder of Variant.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Jesse Walden, the founder of Variant, an early-stage venture firm investing in crypto networks and platforms building the ownership economy. With all the hype surrounding NFTs, I wanted to talk to Jesse about them. The conversation did not disappoint.

key_points.text: With all the hype surrounding NFTs, I wanted to talk to Jesse about them.
We discuss the basics of what an NFT is, what new creative paradigms they might unlock.
This episode is the first in what will likely become its own show we are calling Primers.
